title: [29.x]Bug 647991 Assembly-to-Order Item Incorrectly Blocks Shipment of Unrelated Sales Order Line
summary: Fixed an issue where posting an inventory pick for a non-ATO sales line could fail when an unrelated ATO line on the same order had outstanding warehouse activity. The fix prevents unnecessary updates to the assembly order when warehouse activity is still pending.
key_points: Non-ATO sales lines can now post independently without being blocked by unrelated ATO items
Added logic to skip assembly order quantity updates when warehouse activities are still outstanding
Event subscriber on warehouse activity post prevents errors from unrelated assembly-to-order lines
Fixes posting failures that occurred when mixed ATO and non-ATO items shared a sales order
quote: Assembly-to-Order Item Incorrectly Blocks Shipment of Unrelated Sales Order Line
